# Generated by tools/build_one_trait_panel.py -- edit the tables there, not this file.
# One Trait 2.5: the Puppets tab shows one row per puppet type, read from these variables on the player
# (rebuilt whenever the panel opens, a tab changes or a puppet is released).
one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = {
	if = { limit = { exists = puppet:external_ruler_puppet } set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_puppet_secular value = puppet:external_ruler_puppet } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_secular } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_secular }
	if = { limit = { exists = puppet:external_theological_agent_puppet } set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_puppet_clerical value = puppet:external_theological_agent_puppet } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_clerical } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_clerical }
	if = { limit = { exists = puppet:theological_agent_puppet } set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_puppet_realm_priest value = puppet:theological_agent_puppet } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_realm_priest } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_realm_priest }
	if = { limit = { exists = puppet:one_trait_external_theological_agent_puppet } set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_clerical value = puppet:one_trait_external_theological_agent_puppet } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_clerical } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_clerical }
	if = { limit = { exists = puppet:one_trait_theological_agent_puppet } set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_realm_priest value = puppet:one_trait_theological_agent_puppet } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_realm_priest } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_realm_priest }
}

# 2.6 R3: clears a pending government confirmation (one_trait_ui_confirm, the armed row number, and
# one_trait_ui_confirm_target, the character it was armed for). Empty-safe; called by every panel scripted
# GUI that does something and by the two menu options that open the panel, so a click on anything else
# never applies a stray confirmation. 2.7 Task 2 (batch-2 handoff, R12): also clears
# one_trait_ui_confirm_title (a list row's armed title), so a stray click elsewhere disarms a list row too.
one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_target } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_target }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_title } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_title }
}

# 2.9 Task 1: opens the panel on scope:one_trait_target. Run on the player (the right-click interaction's
# on_accept runs it on the actor): exactly what the retired event menu's panel option did (target, Character
# category and its first sub-tab, confirm cleared, puppets rebuilt, window open).
one_trait_ui_open_panel_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_target value = scope:one_trait_target }
	set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_tab value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_subtab value = 1 }
	one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
	one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	set_variable = one_trait_ui_open
}


# ---- Character 2.6 Task 2: the five stepper rows' shared step effects. root = the player; the target is
# var:one_trait_ui_target. $AMOUNT$ is a literal number the calling scripted GUI supplies. No refresh effect (batch-3 handoff:
# the rows read the target live, Proven Task 0): each effect only changes the target's value.
one_trait_ui_grandeur_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = one_trait_ui_target
			var:one_trait_ui_target = { has_royal_court = yes }
		}
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { change_current_court_grandeur = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
# add_gold ignores a negative amount (Pantheon of One, Task 0 round 4; seen again in the 2.6 look), so a
# loss is taken with remove_short_term_gold and a value block (game/common/character_interactions/
# pam_interactions.txt:23847). Gold may go below zero, as it does in the game.
one_trait_ui_gold_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = {
			set_local_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_gold_amount value = $AMOUNT$ }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:one_trait_ui_gold_amount < 0 }
				remove_short_term_gold = {
					value = local_var:one_trait_ui_gold_amount
					multiply = -1
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_gold = local_var:one_trait_ui_gold_amount
			}
		}
	}
}
one_trait_ui_influence_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { change_influence = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
one_trait_ui_merit_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { change_merit = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
one_trait_ui_legitimacy_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { add_legitimacy = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
# 2.7.1: add_prestige gives or takes prestige (script_docs effects.log:3200).
one_trait_ui_prestige_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { add_prestige = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
# 2.7.1: add_piety gives or takes piety (script_docs effects.log:3169, "gives (or takes)").
one_trait_ui_piety_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { add_piety = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
# 2.7.1: renown is the dynasty's prestige; add_dynasty_prestige runs in dynasty scope (effects.log:16167).
# A lowborn character has no dynasty: nothing happens.
one_trait_ui_renown_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_prestige = $AMOUNT$ } }
	}
}
# 2.8: add_stress increases (or decreases) stress (effects.log:3278); the amount may be negative (vanilla
# common/character_interactions/10_tgp_interactions.txt:3907, "add_stress = -1").
one_trait_ui_stress_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { add_stress = $AMOUNT$ }
	}
}
# Age (spec section 2, Proven Task 0: set_age accepts a computed value). An adult never goes below 16. A
# child may go down to 0; a step that would reach or pass 16 lands exactly on 16 and fires coming of age
# once, as the retired "make them 16" option did (set_age skips birthday on-actions). is_adult is read
# before set_age runs.
one_trait_ui_age_step_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = {
			set_local_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_new_age value = { value = age add = $AMOUNT$ } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_adult = yes }
				if = { limit = { local_var:one_trait_ui_new_age < 16 } set_local_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_new_age value = 16 } }
				set_age = local_var:one_trait_ui_new_age
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { local_var:one_trait_ui_new_age >= 16 }
				set_age = 16
				trigger_event = { on_action = on_16th_birthday }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { local_var:one_trait_ui_new_age < 0 } set_local_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_new_age value = 0 } }
				set_age = local_var:one_trait_ui_new_age
			}
		}
	}
}


# ---- Realm 2.6 Task 3: one_trait_ui_law_effect (root = the player) and one click effect per government
# (R3: the scripted GUI only calls it, so the suite can test arming/cancelling/applying directly).
one_trait_ui_law_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { add_realm_law_skip_effects = $LAW$ }
	}
}

# Age +1. A child this step would bring to 16 comes of age for good, so the first click arms
# (one number for both plus buttons: either confirms it) and a second click on a plus button that also
# reaches 16, for the same character, applies. Any other step applies at once.
one_trait_ui_age_p1_click_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm
				var:one_trait_ui_confirm = 101
				has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_target
				var:one_trait_ui_confirm_target = var:one_trait_ui_target
				var:one_trait_ui_target = {
					is_adult = no
					age >= 15
				}
			}
			one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
			one_trait_ui_age_step_effect = { AMOUNT = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				var:one_trait_ui_target = {
					is_adult = no
					age >= 15
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm value = 101 }
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm_target value = var:one_trait_ui_target }
		}
		else = {
			one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
			one_trait_ui_age_step_effect = { AMOUNT = 1 }
		}
	}
}

			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_target
			var:one_trait_ui_target = { one_trait_government_steppe_admin_effect = yes }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm value = 15 }
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm_target value = var:one_trait_ui_target }
		}
	}
}


# ---- Realm / action rows (2.7 Task 2, batch-2 handoff): one click effect per ALL_ACTIONS key
# (2.8: `area` picks the hand-written effect, one_trait_<area>_<key>_effect). A
# non-confirm action clears any pending confirm, saves scope:one_trait_target from the variable (the same
# idiom the probe proved, OneTraitRealmProto/common/scripted_guis/one_trait_realm_proto_guis.txt:87), then
# calls the hand-written effect (which, for Succession, re-enters scope:one_trait_target itself -- R1). A
# confirm action manages one_trait_ui_confirm/_confirm_target itself (the government rows' own form above),
# so it must not also call the shared clear effect on its arming branch.
one_trait_ui_act_succession_heir_everything_click_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { save_scope_as = one_trait_target }
		one_trait_realm_succession_heir_everything_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---- Realm / list rows (2.7 Task 2, batch-2 handoff, R11/R12): one click effect per list button.
# scope:landed_title is already set (AddScope, from the scripted GUI's call), so the hand-written effect
# reads it directly -- no re-scoping needed here. A confirm button (the plague list) also arms/matches
# one_trait_ui_confirm_title alongside the number and the target (R12).
one_trait_ui_list_titles_take_one_take_click_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { save_scope_as = one_trait_target }
		one_trait_realm_titles_take_one_take_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_list_titles_take_one_claim_click_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { save_scope_as = one_trait_target }
		one_trait_realm_titles_take_one_claim_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_list_titles_take_one_destroy_click_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_target }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm
				var:one_trait_ui_confirm = 207
				has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_target
				var:one_trait_ui_confirm_target = var:one_trait_ui_target
				has_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_title
				scope:landed_title = var:one_trait_ui_confirm_title
			}
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_target
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_confirm_title
			var:one_trait_ui_target = { save_scope_as = one_trait_target }
			one_trait_realm_titles_take_one_destroy_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm value = 207 }
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm_target value = var:one_trait_ui_target }
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_confirm_title value = scope:landed_title }
		}
	}
}
